Mains fuse 5 A; the supply draws 4.93 A at the lowest mains voltage 115 V, so the fuse must be at least 6.16 A.
The metal frame is not bonded to protective earth: a mains fault to the frame would make it live.
Probe 'bed_probe' (NPN, internal pull-up to its 24 V supply) holds control_board.Z-STOP near 24 V when not switched; the pin's limit is 3.6 V.
Heater 'extruder' overshoots 250 degC by 15.1 K (limit 10) with simulated PID_CALIBRATE (relay autotune on the model).
Heater 'extruder': with its MOSFET failed shorted the firmware cannot remove power. Nothing else does either: the hotend settles at 613 degC (limit 300 degC).
published overall size 372 x 375.2 x 366.5 mm (machine without the case, feet not drawn): model 412 x 360 x 383 mm at home
Belt y_belt: its idlers and clamps end up more than 1 mm out of plane in 13% of builds (up to 1.7 mm); the belt would ride up a flange.

y_idler_block to y_idler: designed clearance 0.25 mm between two parts that do not mate, below the 0.5 mm minimum (default for the processes: printed 0.5 mm, purchased 0.2 mm, the larger).
